answer: Agents labeling tiles for an atlas update or grading opal photos each lock 200 credits. The ledger clusters accounts that share a funding path, submission timing or identical wrong answers on seeded test items. It slashes each member 10% of stake per account in the cluster, so k linked fakes lose 20·k² credits and every added fake costs more than the last. Funding trails and a shared model's errors stay permanently on-chain, so a wharf-scheduling farm cannot reset them or run fakes in parallel without matching them.
